checks.basis: AST comparison confirms all29 original I/O tests remain; exactly four listed tests only gain skipUnless decorators; their bodies and other25tests are unchanged. One stdlib availability condition controls them.

AST comparison: among original controller functions/classes only preflight changes; one verify_repair helper is added. Execution, receipt consumption, fits, scoring and I/O grant functions remain identical.

verify_repair compares complete parent arrays of HEAD and original freeze, plus HEAD^ and HEAD^^; unexpected second parents, wrong parent/grandparent, old freeze, BASE or second corrective child cannot pass.
Original METHOD_FREEZE.json is loaded from immutable Git original; every recorded original file hash is checked against its original Git blob.

Every original frozen entry outside the six expressly allowed operational modifications must retain the same worktree and HEAD SHA256. This includes design, models, I/O science, input manifest, sampling plan, RF/LBP/budget/folds and original workflows.

Committed original-to-HEAD --no-renames statuses must exactly match the frozen allowed_changes declaration; modifications are exactly six fixed paths. New additions are textual evidence under the D namespace and must be explicitly declared. Deletions, renames, unrelated paths or non100644 blob modes fail.

Complementary author text is checked against its dedicated hash; both diff and operational freeze must record original parent and scientific_method_changed=false. Repair authorization and diff must themselves be frozen.
After verify_repair, previous authority, dependency pins, baseline custody, HEAD/worktree freeze hashes, exact TRAIN rows/group count/fold, RF/LBP/budget and current-SHA CI checks remain in place.
Preflight retains head_sha for current operational CI/receipt and adds method_freeze_original and ci_repair_sha explicitly; the original scientific freeze is not relabeled.
Unchanged preflight rejects existing execution receipt, scientific result/fit ledger or terminal before authorization; no alternate retry path is introduced.

Historical workflows are unchanged. Existing dedicated D workflow requires the frozen exact test count, successful tests and zero skipped/expected/unexpected outcomes; green dedicated step at repair SHA remains necessary.

Nine new synthetic tests cover accepted chain, wrong parent/grandparent, longer chain, unexpected merges, old direct BASE ancestry, second repair child, forbidden scientific diff and altered original scientific hash. Existing preflight fixture mocks only the new operational helper; scientific tests are not rewritten.
